psychological_meaning: Ebony, a deep and dark shade of black, often evokes feelings of sophistication, mystery, and elegance. It can also represent power, authority, and a sense of the unknown. In some contexts, it can be associated with mourning or formality, but generally, it projects a sense of timelessness and strength.
